title: A Smart Classroom
subtitle: 考点：There be / 位置 / 现代教室
passage: Our classroom is special. There is a smart whiteboard at the front. It is like a big screen. Teachers can put up pictures and videos on it. At the back of the classroom, there are two bookcases with many books.
Each student has a locker and a drawer. I keep my sports clothes in the locker and my pens in the drawer. In the corner, there is a plant. Our modern classroom is amazing.
vocab: smart 智能的 · whiteboard 白板 · screen 屏幕 · locker 有锁存物柜 · drawer 抽屉 · bookcase 书架 · corner 角 · special 特别的 · modern 现代的

questions.why: Teachers can put up pictures and videos on it.
